ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface area against a low-intensity black perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central high-intensity white region occupying the core of both lobes; contiguous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and tips; localized low-intensity speckling on the distal right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 20% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of jagged peaks varies from 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex curve toward the distal outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete low-intensity circular clusters observed on the distal tip of the right lobe and along the inner margin of the left trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged indentations and notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating potential mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant near-total depigmentation of the ventral surface, categorizing the fluke as a Type 4 or 5 coloration pattern.
